name: TML-Bench
description: TML-Bench is a tabular benchmark designed for evaluating data science agents on Kaggle-style tabular machine learning tasks under various time budgets, focusing on end-to-end correctness and reliability.
reputation: A recent benchmark proposed for Kaggle-style tabular ML agents, with emerging interest but limited established adoption so far.
notes: Evaluates models on four Kaggle competitions with multiple time budgets and multiple runs per task.
